findings.translation_quote:
How can we live a morally pure life?

Be Humble. James 5 says, “Confess your faults one to another that ye may be healed.” It takes humility and brokenness to acknowledge our needs, but brokenness is the key to victory. I Peter 5:5 tells us that God gives grace to the humble. ...

Be Honest. Examine your thoughts, actions, temptations, the things you struggle with, anger, lust, pride, bitterness, etc. ...

Be transparent. Romans 2:16 tells of the day when God will judge the secrets of men. ...

Tell yourself the truth. ...

Teach your eyes to bounce. You can't help what you look at the first time, but you can control what you look at twice. ...

Teaching our children. This should be heavy on our hearts from early childhood. ...

Keep your emotions. This is a safety in our corrupt society. ...

Flee lust and fornication. Run from it! ...

findings.source_quote:
Two forces lie within my breast,
The one I love, the one I hate.
But the one I feed will dominate.

—The author’s dad

The more honestly I name
what is true about myself,
The less I need to hide and defend,
and posture and pretend.

—Dan Allender
